notes.vllm_env: vllm==0.11.0 on torch 2.8.0+cu128 (latest vllm wheels need CUDA 13 / driver >=580; this box is on 12.8)
notes.fused_recipe: from-scratch Triton kernels fused into one CUDA-graph-captured decode step: fused RMSNorm+QKV-bias GEMV, fused RoPE+KV-cache-write, split-K flash-decode attention, fused RMSNorm+gate/up+SwiGLU, o/down GEMV with residual epilogue. autotuned per matrix shape (small BN to fill SMs, wide BK for K streaming). verified argmax-identical to a hand-rolled torch oracle over prefill+greedy decode.
notes.result: beat vLLM 4.414 -> 3.716 (1.19x faster, 269 vs 227 tok/s), 1.21x the 3.063ms memory floor. every op is now a fused kernel at its bandwidth/compute floor; residual gap to floor is intrinsic small-matrix (qkv/o) inefficiency + attention compute.
